_comment: Docs-facing extras applied by tools/sync_release_docs.py:enhance_spec(). FastAPI does not emit any of this; Mintlify reads all of it from the published spec. tag_descriptions and request_examples are maintained automatically by the spec extras sync workflow (tools/fix_spec_extras.py) - edit them here, not in the Python source. request_examples is keyed by "METHOD /path" rather than FastAPI's operationId: the operationId embeds the handler function name, so renaming a handler silently orphaned its example.

tag_descriptions.add: Data ingestion endpoints for adding text, files, and structured data.
tag_descriptions.auth: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and token management.
tag_descriptions.cognify: Knowledge processing endpoints to transform raw data into knowledge graphs.
tag_descriptions.datasets: Dataset management endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting datasets.
tag_descriptions.delete: Data deletion endpoints (deprecated — use datasets endpoints instead).
tag_descriptions.permissions: Permission management for multi-user access control.
tag_descriptions.responses: Response generation endpoints using the knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.search: Search endpoints for querying the knowledge graph.
tag_descriptions.settings: Configuration endpoints for managing Cognee settings.

POST /api/v1/add.data: Cognee is a knowledge graph platform for AI applications.
